title: Labels
subtitle: Choose products, set the size and print your barcode labels.
search: Search by name, SKU or barcode
codeHint: We use the saved barcode or, if empty, the numeric SKU. Enter 1 to 32 digits to print.
a4Hint: A4 sheet with 5 mm margins and 2 mm gaps. Check alignment before using pre-cut adhesive sheets.
rollHint: PDF with one label per page, no outer margins or added gaps. Use the actual label size and match it in the driver.
invalidSize: Use a width of 3–20 cm and a height of 2–20 cm.
emptyPreview: Select a product to preview its label.
previewHint: Content preview. The PDF preserves millimetre dimensions. Test barcode scanning before printing a batch.
printHint: PDF at exact physical size. In the browser, use 100% scale and matching paper size. Configure QZ Tray for direct printing.
quantityError: Use whole quantities starting at 1, with a maximum of {max} labels per print job.
narrowError: A product code is too long for this width. Choose a wider label to keep it readable.
printError: Print submission failed. Check QZ Tray, the selected printer and its queue before retrying to avoid duplicate copies.
qzHint: Install and open QZ Tray on this computer and authorize this site. Printing without prompts requires a server certificate.
autoReceipt: Print automatically when a sale is recorded
downloadHint: Preferences are saved in this browser. PDFs go to Downloads; your browser may ask where to save.
settingsError: Could not save preferences in this browser.
noPrinters: No printers found. Check the installed driver.
connectionError: Could not connect. Open QZ Tray, authorize this site and try again.
printSubmitted: Job submitted. Check the print queue and printer output.
continuousHint: Prints labels together on the same strip without feeding a separate page per label. Use for continuous thermal paper.
knupHint: Nominal 58 mm roll; 48 mm printable area. Labels are centered on a continuous roll. Set the driver paper size to 58 mm.
knupSizeError: The KP-1025 prints up to 48 mm wide and does not use A4. Choose a width of up to 4.8 cm and continuous roll or individual labels.
